intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Montgomery for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Deck the Pines at Pine Market in Woodforest) through December 21 (Gingerbread House Making), with December 10 (Christmas Open House and Santa), December 11 (Playtime with Santa: A Winter Magic Experience) and December 12 (Lone Star Christmas Parade in Historic Downtown Montgomery) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Montgomery

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Montgomery
  • 5 free events, including the Lone Star Christmas Parade, Deck the Pines and Kressmas at Kresston
  • Meet Santa: Deck the Pines, Kressmas at Kresston, Christmas Open House and Santa
  • Parades: Lone Star Christmas Parade in Historic Downtown Montgomery on December 12
  • Candlelight and cookies: Christmas in Historic Montgomery and Candlelight Home Tour
  • Season: December 4 to December 21

Planning a bigger day out? Montgomery families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
